study type: Sub-study nested within a randomized controlled trial (Baby-Directed Umbilical Cord-Clamping trial) with an additional observational arm.
cohort: The study included 161 infants >=32+0 weeks' gestation, with 55 randomized (requiring resuscitation) and 106 vigorous infants in an observational arm.
finding: There was no significant difference in blood pressure (BP) or cerebral tissue oxygen saturation (rStO2) among infants receiving physiologically-based cord clamping, early cord clamping, or deferred cord clamping in the immediate postnatal period.
followup_time: Observations were taken immediately after birth, specifically at 3-4 minutes and 6 minutes for BP and rStO2.
gest_age: Infants >=32+0 weeks' gestation (late-preterm and full-term infants)
